      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\"use client\"\n\nimport { useEffect, useRef, useState } from \"react\"\nimport { motion } from \"framer-motion\"\nimport { AlertCircle, Info } from \"lucide-react\"\n\n// This component will attempt to load Three.js dynamically and provide a fallback\nexport default function GlobeVisualization() {\n  const canvasRef = useRef\u003cHTMLCanvasElement\u003e(null)\n  const [loadingState, setLoadingState] = useState\u003c\"loading\" | \"success\" | \"error\"\u003e(\"loading\")\n  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n\n  // Dynamic import of Three.js\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    let mounted = true\n    let animationFrameId: number\n\n    const loadThreeJs = async () =\u003e {\n      try {\n        // Simulate loading Three.js\n        await new Promise((resolve) =\u003e setTimeout(resolve, 1500))\n\n        // Randomly simulate success or error for demonstration\n        const success = Math.random() \u003e 0.5\n\n        if (!mounted) return\n\n        if (success) {\n          setLoadingState(\"success\")\n          // In a real implementation, you would initialize Three.js here\n          // initThreeJsGlobe()\n        } else {\n          throw new Error(\"Failed to load 3D visualization library\")\n        }\n      } catch (error) {\n        if (!mounted) return\n        console.error(\"Error loading Three.js:\", error)\n        setErrorMessage(error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"Unknown error\")\n        setLoadingState(\"error\")\n\n        // Initialize fallback 2D canvas visualization\n        initFallbackCanvas()\n      }\n    }",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\"use client\"\n\nimport type React from \"react\"\n\nimport { useState, useEffect, useRef } from \"react\"\nimport { motion, AnimatePresence } from \"framer-motion\"\nimport { Card } from \"@/components/ui/card\"\nimport { Database, Search, X, AlertCircle } from \"lucide-react\"\nimport AnimatedFolder from \"./animated-folder\"\nimport EvidenceDetailSidebar from \"./evidence-detail-sidebar\"\nimport { createFuzzySearch, searchFiles, type SearchableFile } from \"@/utils/fuzzy-search\"\nimport { getAllDocuments, getDocumentsByType } from \"@/utils/documents-data\"\n\ninterface FileItem {\n  id: string\n  name: string\n  type: \"file\" | \"image\" | \"video\" | \"attachment\"\n  size?: string\n  classification?: \"top-secret\" | \"classified\" | \"confidential\" | \"restricted\" | \"unclassified\"\n}",

        "contents": "import { Editor } from '@tiptap/react'\nimport { RAGLLMHandler } from '@/lib/tiptap/custom-llm-handler'\nimport { toast } from '@/components/ui/use-toast'\nimport { useState } from 'react'\n\nexport function useRAGCommands(editor: Editor | null) {\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)\n  const ragHandler = new RAGLLMHandler()\n\n  const handleRAGSearch = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!editor) return\n    \n    const { from, to } = editor.state.selection\n    const selectedText = editor.state.doc.textBetween(from, to)\n    \n    if (!selectedText) {\n      toast({\n        title: \"No text selected\",\n        description: \"Please select text to search in the knowledge base.\",\n        variant: \"destructive\"\n      })\n      return\n    }\n\n    setLoading(true)\n    try {\n      const results = await ragHandler.searchDocuments(selectedText)\n      \n      if (results.length === 0) {\n        toast({\n          title: \"No results found\",\n          description: \"No relevant documents found in the knowledge base.\",\n        })\n        return\n      }\n      \n      // For now, insert the first result as a comment\n      // In a full implementation, show a modal to select from results\n      const firstResult = results[0]\n      editor.chain()\n        .focus()\n        .insertContent(&#96;\\n\\n**Related Document:** ${firstResult.title}\\n${firstResult.summary}\\n&#96;)\n        .run()\n        \n      toast({\n        title: \"Search complete\",\n        description: &#96;Found ${results.length} related documents.&#96;,\n      })\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast({\n        title: \"Search failed\",\n        description: \"Could not search the knowledge base. Please try again.\",\n        variant: \"destructive\"\n      })\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false)\n    }\n  }",

        "originalContents": "import { Editor } from '@tiptap/react'\nimport { RAGLLMHandler } from '@/lib/tiptap/custom-llm-handler'\nimport { toast } from '@/components/ui/use-toast'\nimport { useState } from 'react'\n\nexport function useRAGCommands(editor: Editor | null) {\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)\n  const ragHandler = new RAGLLMHandler()\n\n  const handleRAGSearch = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!editor) return\n    \n    const { from, to } = editor.state.selection\n    const selectedText = editor.state.doc.textBetween(from, to)\n    \n    if (!selectedText) {\n      toast({\n        title: \"No text selected\",\n        description: \"Please select text to search in the knowledge base.\",\n        variant: \"destructive\"\n      })\n      return\n    }\n\n    setLoading(true)\n    try {\n      const results = await ragHandler.searchDocuments(selectedText)\n      \n      if (results.length === 0) {\n        toast({\n          title: \"No results found\",\n          description: \"No relevant documents found in the knowledge base.\",\n        })\n        return\n      }\n      \n      // For now, insert the first result as a comment\n      // In a full implementation, show a modal to select from results\n      const firstResult = results[0]\n      editor.chain()\n        .focus()\n        .insertContent(&#96;\\n\\n**Related Document:** ${firstResult.title}\\n${firstResult.summary}\\n&#96;)\n        .run()\n        \n      toast({\n        title: \"Search complete\",\n        description: &#96;Found ${results.length} related documents.&#96;,\n      })\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast({\n        title: \"Search failed\",\n        description: \"Could not search the knowledge base. Please try again.\",\n        variant: \"destructive\"\n      })\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false)\n    }\n  }",

        "contents": "\"use client\"\n\nimport { useRef, useMemo, useEffect, useCallback } from \"react\"\nimport { Canvas, useFrame, useThree } from \"@react-three/fiber\"\nimport { OrbitControls, Sphere, useTexture } from \"@react-three/drei\"\nimport * as THREE from \"three\"\nimport { Color } from \"three\"\n\nfunction Earth({ focusedLocation }: { focusedLocation: { lat: number; lon: number } | null }) {\n  const earthRef = useRef\u003cTHREE.Mesh\u003e(null)\n  const cloudsRef = useRef\u003cTHREE.Mesh\u003e(null)\n  const atmosphereRef = useRef\u003cTHREE.Mesh\u003e(null)\n  const particlesRef = useRef\u003cTHREE.Points\u003e(null)\n  const controlsRef = useRef\u003cany\u003e(null)\n\n  const { camera } = useThree()\n\n  // Load Earth textures\n  const [earthMap, earthNormalMap, earthSpecularMap, earthCloudsMap] = useTexture([\n    \"/assets/3d/texture_earth.jpg\",\n    \"/assets/3d/texture_earth.jpg\",\n    \"/assets/3d/texture_earth.jpg\",\n    \"/assets/3d/texture_earth.jpg\",\n  ])\n\n  // Create particles for the surrounding field\n  const particles = useMemo(() =\u003e {\n    const temp = []\n    for (let i = 0; i \u003c 1000; i++) {\n      const phi = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2\n      const theta = Math.random() * Math.PI\n      const r = 2.5 + Math.random() * 0.2\n\n      temp.push(r * Math.cos(phi) * Math.sin(theta), r * Math.sin(phi) * Math.sin(theta), r * Math.cos(theta))\n    }\n    return new Float32Array(temp)\n  }, [])",

        "contents": "\n\n// Hook for documents with pagination and filtering\nexport const useDocuments = (initialParams: {\n  docType?: string;\n  tags?: string;\n  limit?: number;\n} = {}) =\u003e {\n  const [documents, setDocuments] = useState\u003cDocumentSummary[]\u003e([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(true);\n  const [offset, setOffset] = useState(0);\n\n  const loadDocuments = useCallback(async (\n    params: typeof initialParams = initialParams,\n    reset = false\n  ) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      setError(null);\n      \n      const currentOffset = reset ? 0 : offset;\n      const data = await getDocuments({\n        ...params,\n        offset: currentOffset,\n        limit: params.limit || 20\n      });\n\n      if (reset) {\n        setDocuments(data);\n        setOffset(data.length);\n      } else {\n        setDocuments(prev =\u003e [...prev, ...data]);\n        setOffset(prev =\u003e prev + data.length);\n      }\n\n      setHasMore(data.length === (params.limit || 20));\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to fetch documents');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [offset, initialParams]);\n\n  const loadMore = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    if (!loading \u0026\u0026 hasMore) {\n      loadDocuments();\n    }\n  }, [loadDocuments, loading, hasMore]);\n\n  const refresh = useCallback((newParams?: typeof initialParams) =\u003e {\n    setOffset(0);\n    loadDocuments(newParams || initialParams, true);\n  }, [loadDocuments, initialParams]);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    refresh();\n  }, []);\n\n  return {\n    documents,\n    loading,\n    error,\n    hasMore,\n    loadMore,\n    refresh\n  };\n};",

        "originalContents": "\n\n// Hook for documents with pagination and filtering\nexport const useDocuments = (initialParams: {\n  docType?: string;\n  tags?: string;\n  limit?: number;\n} = {}) =\u003e {\n  const [documents, setDocuments] = useState\u003cDocumentSummary[]\u003e([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(true);\n  const [offset, setOffset] = useState(0);\n\n  const loadDocuments = useCallback(async (\n    params: typeof initialParams = initialParams,\n    reset = false\n  ) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      setError(null);\n      \n      const currentOffset = reset ? 0 : offset;\n      const data = await getDocuments({\n        ...params,\n        offset: currentOffset,\n        limit: params.limit || 20\n      });\n\n      if (reset) {\n        setDocuments(data);\n        setOffset(data.length);\n      } else {\n        setDocuments(prev =\u003e [...prev, ...data]);\n        setOffset(prev =\u003e prev + data.length);\n      }\n\n      setHasMore(data.length === (params.limit || 20));\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to fetch documents');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [offset, initialParams]);\n\n  const loadMore = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    if (!loading \u0026\u0026 hasMore) {\n      loadDocuments();\n    }\n  }, [loadDocuments, loading, hasMore]);\n\n  const refresh = useCallback((newParams?: typeof initialParams) =\u003e {\n    setOffset(0);\n    loadDocuments(newParams || initialParams, true);\n  }, [loadDocuments, initialParams]);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    refresh();\n  }, []);\n\n  return {\n    documents,\n    loading,\n    error,\n    hasMore,\n    loadMore,\n    refresh\n  };\n};",

        "contents": "import { Editor } from '@tiptap/react'\nimport { RAGLLMHandler } from '@/lib/tiptap/custom-llm-handler'\nimport { toast } from '@/components/ui/use-toast'\nimport { useState } from 'react'\n\nexport function useRAGCommands(editor: Editor | null) {\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)\n  const ragHandler = new RAGLLMHandler()\n\n  const handleRAGSearch = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!editor) return\n    \n    const { from, to } = editor.state.selection\n    const selectedText = editor.state.doc.textBetween(from, to)\n    \n    if (!selectedText) {\n      toast({\n        title: \"No text selected\",\n        description: \"Please select text to search in the knowledge base.\",\n        variant: \"destructive\"\n      })\n      return\n    }\n\n    setLoading(true)\n    try {\n      const results = await ragHandler.searchDocuments(selectedText)\n      \n      if (results.length === 0) {\n        toast({\n          title: \"No results found\",\n          description: \"No relevant documents found in the knowledge base.\",\n        })\n        return\n      }\n      \n      // For now, insert the first result as a comment\n      // In a full implementation, show a modal to select from results\n      const firstResult = results[0]\n      editor.chain()\n        .focus()\n        .insertContent(&#96;\\n\\n**Related Document:** ${firstResult.title}\\n${firstResult.summary}\\n&#96;)\n        .run()\n        \n      toast({\n        title: \"Search complete\",\n        description: &#96;Found ${results.length} related documents.&#96;,\n      })\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast({\n        title: \"Search failed\",\n        description: \"Could not search the knowledge base.         "originalContents": "import { Editor } from '@tiptap/react'\nimport { RAGLLMHandler } from '@/lib/tiptap/custom-llm-handler'\nimport { toast } from '@/components/ui/use-toast'\nimport { useState } from 'react'\n\nexport function useRAGCommands(editor: Editor | null) {\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)\n  const ragHandler = new RAGLLMHandler()\n\n  const handleRAGSearch = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!editor) return\n    \n    const { from, to } = editor.state.selection\n    const selectedText = editor.state.doc.textBetween(from, to)\n    \n    if (!selectedText) {\n      toast({\n        title: \"No text selected\",\n        description: \"Please select text to search in the knowledge base.\",\n        variant: \"destructive\"\n      })\n      return\n    }\n\n    setLoading(true)\n    try {\n      const results = await ragHandler.searchDocuments(selectedText)\n      \n      if (results.length === 0) {\n        toast({\n          title: \"No results found\",\n          description: \"No relevant documents found in the knowledge base.\",\n        })\n        return\n      }\n      \n      // For now, insert the first result as a comment\n      // In a full implementation, show a modal to select from results\n      const firstResult = results[0]\n      editor.chain()\n        .focus()\n        .insertContent(&#96;\\n\\n**Related Document:** ${firstResult.title}\\n${firstResult.summary}\\n&#96;)\n        .run()\n        \n      toast({\n        title: \"Search complete\",\n        description: &#96;Found ${results.length} related documents.&#96;,\n      })\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast({\n        title: \"Search failed\",\n        description: \"Could not search the knowledge base.       "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export function useRAGCommands(editor: Editor | null) {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const handleRAGSummarize = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!editor) return\n    \n    const { from, to } = editor.state.selection\n    const selectedText = editor.state.doc.textBetween(from, to)\n    \n    if (!selectedText) {\n      // If no selection, summarize entire document\n      const fullText = editor.getText()\n      if (!fullText) {\n        toast({\n          title: \"No content\",\n          description: \"The document is empty.\",\n          variant: \"destructive\"\n        })\n        return\n      }\n    }\n    \n    const textToSummarize = selectedText || editor.getText()\n    \n    setLoading(true)\n    try {\n      // Search for related sources\n      const sources = await ragHandler.searchDocuments(textToSummarize.slice(0, 200))\n      \n      // Generate summary\n      const prompt = &#96;Summarize this text and include relevant information from the knowledge base: \"${textToSummarize}\"&#96;\n      \n      const summary = await ragHandler.generateText(prompt, {\n        context: sources.map(s =\u003e s.summary).join('\\n'),\n        maxTokens: 200\n      })\n      \n      // Insert summary\n      editor.chain()\n        .focus()\n        .insertContent(&#96;\\n\\n**Summary:**\\n${summary}\\n\\n**Sources:**\\n${\n          sources.map(s =\u003e &#96;- ${s.title}&#96;).join('\\n')\n        }\\n&#96;)\n        .run()\n        \n      toast({\n        title: \"Summary complete\",\n        description: &#96;Created summary with ${sources.length} sources.&#96;,\n      })\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast({\n        title: \"Summary failed\",\n        description: \"Could not create summary. Please try again.\",\n        variant: \"destructive\"\n      })\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false)\n    }\n  }\n\n  return {\n    handleRAGSearch,\n    handleRAGFactCheck,\n    handleRAGCite,\n    handleRAGElaborate,\n    handleRAGSummarize,\n    loading\n  }\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  const handleRAGSummarize = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!editor) return\n    \n    const { from, to } = editor.state.selection\n    const selectedText = editor.state.doc.textBetween(from, to)\n    \n    if (!selectedText) {\n      // If no selection, summarize entire document\n      const fullText = editor.getText()\n      if (!fullText) {\n        toast({\n          title: \"No content\",\n          description: \"The document is empty.\",\n          variant: \"destructive\"\n        })\n        return\n      }\n    }\n    \n    const textToSummarize = selectedText || editor.getText()\n    \n    setLoading(true)\n    try {\n      // Search for related sources\n      const sources = await ragHandler.searchDocuments(textToSummarize.slice(0, 200))\n      \n      // Generate summary\n      const prompt = &#96;Summarize this text and include relevant information from the knowledge base: \"${textToSummarize}\"&#96;\n      \n      const summary = await ragHandler.generateText(prompt, {\n        context: sources.map(s =\u003e s.summary).join('\\n'),\n        maxTokens: 200\n      })\n      \n      // Insert summary\n      editor.chain()\n        .focus()\n        .insertContent(&#96;\\n\\n**Summary:**\\n${summary}\\n\\n**Sources:**\\n${\n          sources.map(s =\u003e &#96;- ${s.title}&#96;).join('\\n')\n        }\\n&#96;)\n        .run()\n        \n      toast({\n        title: \"Summary complete\",\n        description: &#96;Created summary with ${sources.length} sources.&#96;,\n      })\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast({\n        title: \"Summary failed\",\n        description: \"Could not create summary. Please try again.\",\n        variant: \"destructive\"\n      })\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false)\n    }\n  }\n\n  return {\n    handleRAGSearch,\n    handleRAGFactCheck,\n    handleRAGCite,\n    handleRAGElaborate,\n    handleRAGSummarize,\n    loading\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "\n\nexport function useRAGSettings() {\n  const [settings, setSettings] = useState\u003cRAGSettings | null\u003e(null)\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    loadSettings()\n  }, [])\n\n  const loadSettings = async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true)\n      const response = await fetch('/api/admin/rag-settings')\n      \n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error('Failed to load settings')\n      }\n      \n      const data = await response.json()\n      setSettings(data)\n      setError(null)\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error')\n      setSettings(null)\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false)\n    }\n  }\n\n  const updateSettings = async (newSettings: Partial\u003cRAGSettings\u003e) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch('/api/admin/rag-settings', {\n        method: 'POST',\n        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },\n        body: JSON.stringify(newSettings)\n      })\n      \n      if (!response.ok) {\n        throw new Error('Failed to update settings')\n      }\n      \n      // Reload settings after update\n      await loadSettings()\n      return true\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error')\n      return false\n    }\n  }\n\n  return {\n    settings,\n    loading,\n    error,\n    reload: loadSettings,\n    update: updateSettings,\n    enabled: settings?.enabled ?? false\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export function useRAGCommands(editor: Editor | null) {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  const handleRAGFactCheck = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!editor) return\n    \n    const { from, to } = editor.state.selection\n    const selectedText = editor.state.doc.textBetween(from, to)\n    \n    if (!selectedText) {\n      toast({\n        title: \"No text selected\",\n        description: \"Please select text to fact check.\",\n        variant: \"destructive\"\n      })\n      return\n    }\n    \n    setLoading(true)\n    try {\n      const factCheck = await ragHandler.factCheck(selectedText)\n      \n      // Apply highlight based on verification status\n      editor.chain()\n        .focus()\n        .setMark('highlight', { \n          color: factCheck.verified ?         "contents": "export function useCursorVisibility({\n  editor,\n  overlayHeight = 0,\n  elementRef = null,\n}: CursorVisibilityOptions) {\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  React.useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const ensureCursorVisibility = () =\u003e {\n      if (!editor) return\n\n      const { state, view } = editor\n\n      if (!view.hasFocus()) return\n\n      // Get current cursor position coordinates\n      const { from } = state.selection\n      const cursorCoords = view.coordsAtPos(from)\n\n      if (windowHeight \u003c rect.height) {\n        if (cursorCoords) {\n          // Check if there's enough space between cursor and bottom of window\n          const availableSpace =\n            windowHeight - cursorCoords.top - overlayHeight \u003e 0\n\n          // If not enough space, scroll to position cursor in the middle of viewport\n          if (!availableSpace) {\n            const targetScrollY =\n              // TODO: Needed?\n              //   window.scrollY + (cursorCoords.top - windowHeight / 2)\n              cursorCoords.top - windowHeight / 2\n\n            window.scrollTo({\n              top: targetScrollY,\n              behavior: \"smooth\",\n            })\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    ensureCursorVisibility()\n  }, [editor, overlayHeight, windowHeight, rect.height])\n\n  return rect\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Custom hook that ensures the cursor remains visible when typing in a TipTap editor.\n * Automatically scrolls the window when the cursor would be hidden by the toolbar.\n *\n * This is particularly useful for long-form content editing where the cursor\n * might move out of the visible area as the user types.\n *\n * @param options Configuration options for cursor visibility behavior\n * @returns void\n */\nexport function useCursorVisibility({\n  editor,\n  overlayHeight = 0,\n  elementRef = null,\n}: CursorVisibilityOptions) {\n  const { height: windowHeight } = useWindowSize()\n  const [rect, setRect] = React.useState\u003cRectState\u003e({\n    x: 0,\n    y: 0,\n    width: 0,\n    height: 0,\n  })\n\n  const updateRect = React.useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    const element = elementRef?.current ?? document.body\n\n    const { x, y, width, height } = element.getBoundingClientRect()\n    setRect({ x, y, width, height })\n  }, [elementRef])\n\n  React.useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const element = elementRef?.current ?? document.body\n\n    updateRect()\n\n    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() =\u003e {\n      window.requestAnimationFrame(updateRect)\n    })\n\n    resizeObserver.observe(element)\n    window.addEventListener(\"scroll\", updateRect, { passive: true })\n\n    return () =\u003e {\n      resizeObserver.disconnect()\n      window.removeEventListener(\"scroll\", updateRect)\n    }\n  }, [elementRef, updateRect])",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Custom hook that ensures the cursor remains visible when typing in a TipTap editor.\n * Automatically scrolls the window when the cursor would be hidden by the toolbar.\n *\n * This is particularly useful for long-form content editing where the cursor\n * might move out of the visible area as the user types.\n *\n * @param options Configuration options for cursor visibility behavior\n * @returns void\n */\nexport function useCursorVisibility({\n  editor,\n  overlayHeight = 0,\n  elementRef = null,\n}: CursorVisibilityOptions) {\n  const { height: windowHeight } = useWindowSize()\n  const [rect, setRect] = React.useState\u003cRectState\u003e({\n    x: 0,\n    y: 0,\n    width: 0,\n    height: 0,\n  })\n\n  const updateRect = React.useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    const element = elementRef?.current ?? document.body\n\n    const { x, y, width, height } = element.getBoundingClientRect()\n    setRect({ x, y, width, height })\n  }, [elementRef])\n\n  React.useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const element = elementRef?.current ?? document.body\n\n    updateRect()\n\n    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() =\u003e {\n      window.requestAnimationFrame(updateRect)\n    })\n\n    resizeObserver.observe(element)\n    window.addEventListener(\"scroll\", updateRect, { passive: true })\n\n    return () =\u003e {\n      resizeObserver.disconnect()\n      window.removeEventListener(\"scroll\", updateRect)\n    }\n  }, [elementRef, updateRect])",

        "originalContents": "# Research Canvas - Knowledge Base Integration\n\nA Next.js research interface that provides access to the complete UFO/UAP knowledge base with 448 classified documents.\n\n## Features\n\n### 🔬 Research Canvas\n- Interactive evidence analysis interface\n- Case management and tracking\n- Evidence cards with classification levels\n- Data grids and network visualization\n\n### 📚 Knowledge Base Browser\n- **448 Documents**: CIA files, transcripts, research papers\n- **Real-time Search**: Full-text search across all documents\n- **Advanced Filtering**: By document type, tags, categories\n- **Statistics Dashboard**: Overview of the complete archive\n\n### 🕸️ Evidence Network\n- Connection mapping between entities\n- Popular research topics visualization\n- Tag-based relationship discovery\n\n### 🔐 Security Features\n- Classification banners and security controls\n- Document access controls\n- Secure API integration\n\n## Quick Start\n\n### 1. Start the Knowledge Base API\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\ncd ../disclosure-rag\n./launch_api.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe API will be available at &#96;http://localhost:8000&#96;\n\n### 2. Launch Research Canvas\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n./launch.sh\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThe interface will be available at &#96;http://localhost:3000&#96;\n\n## Architecture\n\n### Frontend (Next.js)\n- **React Components**: Modern UI components with Tailwind CSS\n- **TypeScript**: Full type safety throughout the application\n- **Custom Hooks**: Data fetching and state management\n- **Responsive Design**: Works on desktop and mobile devices\n\n### Backend Integration\n- **FastAPI**: Knowledge base REST API\n- **Real-time Data**: Live access to 448 documents\n- **Search Engine**: Full-text search with faceted filtering\n- **Caching**: Optimized performance with smart caching\n\n## Data Sources\n\nThe knowledge base contains:\n\n- **31 PDF Case Files**: CIA documents, UAP reports, congressional hearings\n- **407 Transcripts**: Joe Rogan podcasts, military testimonies, disclosure interviews  \n- **10 Research Articles**: Academic papers and investigations\n\n### Document Categories\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n**Case Files:**\n- CIA Documents (RDP series)\n- UFO/UAP Reports  \n- Project Blue Book files\n- Congressional Hearings\n- Witness Testimony\n- Roswell Incident files\n\n**Transcripts:**\n- Joe Rogan Podcast episodes\n- Military/Navy testimonies\n- Disclosure-related interviews\n- David Grusch testimonies\n- Luis Elizondo interviews\n\n## Development\n\n### Environment Variables\n\nCreate &#96;.env.local&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\nNEXT_PUBLIC_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_API_URL=http://localhost:8000\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Commands\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install dependencies\nnpm install\n\n# Start development server\nnpm run dev\n\n# Build for production\nnpm run build\n\n# Start production server\nnpm start\n\n# Run linting\nnpm run lint\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\napps/research-canvas/\n├── components/\n│   ├── ui/                    # Reusable UI components\n│   ├── integrated-dashboard.tsx   # Main dashboard\n│   ├── knowledge-base-browser.tsx # Knowledge base interface\n│   └── ...\n├── hooks/\n│   └── use-knowledge-base.ts  # Data fetching hooks\n├── lib/\n│   ├── knowledge-base-api.ts  # API client functions\n│   └── utils.ts              # Utility functions\n├── app/                      # Next.js app directory\n├── utils/                    # Data utilities\n└── ...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## API Integration\n\n### Available Endpoints\n\n- &#96;GET /stats&#96; - Knowledge base statistics\n- &#96;GET /documents&#96; - List documents with filtering\n- &#96;GET /documents/{id}&#96; - Get specific document\n- &#96;GET /search&#96; - Search documents\n- &#96;GET /tags&#96;     {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "// React hooks for Knowledge Base data\n// Custom hooks for fetching and managing knowledge base data\n\nimport { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';\nimport { \n  getStats, \n  getDocuments, \n  searchDocuments, \n  getTags, \n  getCategories,\n  type KnowledgeBaseStats,\n  type DocumentSummary,\n  type SearchResults,\n  type Tag,\n  type Categories\n} from '../lib/knowledge-base-api';\n\n// Hook for knowledge base statistics\nexport const useKnowledgeBaseStats = () =\u003e {\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cKnowledgeBaseStats | null\u003e(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n\n  const fetchStats = useCallback(async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      setError(null);\n      const data = await getStats();\n      setStats(data);\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to fetch stats');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    fetchStats();\n  }, [fetchStats]);\n\n  return { stats, loading, error, refetch: fetchStats };\n};",
        "detailedLines": [
          {

        "originalContents": "// React hooks for Knowledge Base data\n// Custom hooks for fetching and managing knowledge base data\n\nimport { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';\nimport { \n  getStats, \n  getDocuments, \n  searchDocuments, \n  getTags, \n  getCategories,\n  type KnowledgeBaseStats,\n  type DocumentSummary,\n  type SearchResults,\n  type Tag,\n  type Categories\n} from '../lib/knowledge-base-api';\n\n// Hook for knowledge base statistics\nexport const useKnowledgeBaseStats = () =\u003e {\n  const [stats, setStats] = useState\u003cKnowledgeBaseStats | null\u003e(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n\n  const fetchStats = useCallback(async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      setError(null);\n      const data = await getStats();\n      setStats(data);\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to fetch stats');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    fetchStats();\n  }, [fetchStats]);\n\n  return { stats, loading, error, refetch: fetchStats };\n};",

        "contents": "1. Create component in &#96;components/&#96; directory\n2. Export from main dashboard\n3. Add to navigation tabs if needed\n\n### Extending the API\n1. Add new functions to &#96;lib/knowledge-base-api.ts&#96;\n2. Create hooks in &#96;hooks/use-knowledge-base.ts&#96;\n3. Use in components\n\n### Styling\n- Uses Tailwind CSS for styling\n- Dark theme optimized for research environments\n- Sci-fi inspired design with classification elements\n\n## Security Considerations\n\n- All API calls are client-side (no sensitive data exposure)\n- Classification banners for document security\n- Environment-based API URL configuration\n- No authentication required for local development\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n### API Connection Issues\n1. Ensure the knowledge base API is running on port 8000\n2. Check the &#96;.env.local&#96; file has the correct API URL\n3. Verify no firewall is blocking the connection\n\n### Missing Documents\n1. Check the API health endpoint: &#96;http://localhost:8000/health&#96;\n2. Verify the knowledge base is indexed\n3. Check the API logs for errors\n\n### Performance Issues\n1. The initial load fetches statistics and first 20 documents\n2. Search and filtering are optimized for large datasets\n3.         "contents": "\n\nexport default function ClassifiedDocumentViewer() {\n  const [document, setDocument] = useState\u003cClassifiedDocument | null\u003e(null)\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true)\n  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(\"content\")\n  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState(\"\")\n  const [newAnnotation, setNewAnnotation] = useState(\"\")\n  const [showAccessWarning, setShowAccessWarning] = useState(true)\n  const [selectedText, setSelectedText] = useState(\"\")\n  const [contextMenuPosition, setContextMenuPosition] = useState\u003c{ x: number; y: number } | null\u003e(null)\n\n  // Refs for annotation functionality\n  const contentRef = useRef\u003cHTMLPreElement\u003e(null)\n\n  // Load document data from our CSV\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const timer = setTimeout(() =\u003e {\n      // Get the main document (first document in our CSV)\n      const mainDoc = getDocumentById(\"DOC-2023-0472\")\n\n      if (mainDoc) {\n        setDocument(convertToClassifiedDocument(mainDoc))\n      }\n\n      setLoading(false)\n    }, 1500)\n\n    return () =\u003e clearTimeout(timer)\n  }, [])\n\n  // Add a new annotation\n  const handleAddAnnotation = () =\u003e {\n    if (!newAnnotation.trim() || !document) return\n\n    const newAnnotationObj = {\n      id: &#96;ANT-${document.annotations.length + 1}&#96;,\n      userId: \"UID-7821\",\n      username: \"e.richards\",\n      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n      text: newAnnotation,\n    }\n\n    setDocument({\n      ...document,\n      annotations: [...document.annotations, newAnnotationObj],\n    })\n\n    setNewAnnotation(\"\")\n  }\n\n  // Handle access warning dismissal\n  const dismissAccessWarning = () =\u003e {\n    setShowAccessWarning(false)\n  }",

        "contents": "\n\nexport default function EvidenceNetwork() {\n  const [selectedEvidence, setSelectedEvidence] = useState\u003cany | null\u003e(null)\n  const [selectedNodeId, setSelectedNodeId] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n\n  // Handle node selection in the connections view\n  const handleNodeSelect = (nodeId: string) =\u003e {\n    setSelectedNodeId(nodeId)\n\n    // Convert node ID to evidence format for the sidebar\n    setSelectedEvidence({\n      id: nodeId,\n      type: 'document',\n      status: 'active',\n      date: '2077-03-15',\n      details: &#96;Evidence file ${nodeId}&#96;,\n      metadata: {\n        createdBy: 'System',\n        lastModified: '2077-03-15 21:27:18',\n        fileSize: '1.2 GB',\n        format: 'Quantum Data Stream',\n      },\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Handle file selection in the browser view\n  const handleFileSelect = (file: FileItem) =\u003e {\n    setSelectedEvidence({\n      id: file.id,\n      type: file.type,\n      status: 'active',\n      date: '2077-03-15',\n      details: &#96;Evidence file: ${file.name}&#96;,\n      metadata: {\n        createdBy: 'System',\n        lastModified: '2077-03-15 21:27:18',\n        fileSize: file.size || 'Unknown',\n        format: file.name.split('.').pop()?.toUpperCase() || 'Unknown',\n      },\n    })\n  }",

        "originalContents": "\n\nexport default function EvidenceNetwork() {\n  const [selectedEvidence, setSelectedEvidence] = useState\u003cany | null\u003e(null)\n  const [selectedNodeId, setSelectedNodeId] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n\n  // Handle node selection in the connections view\n  const handleNodeSelect = (nodeId: string) =\u003e {\n    setSelectedNodeId(nodeId)\n\n    // Convert node ID to evidence format for the sidebar\n    setSelectedEvidence({\n      id: nodeId,\n      type: 'document',\n      status: 'active',\n      date: '2077-03-15',\n      details: &#96;Evidence file ${nodeId}&#96;,\n      metadata: {\n        createdBy: 'System',\n        lastModified: '2077-03-15 21:27:18',\n        fileSize: '1.2 GB',\n        format: 'Quantum Data Stream',\n      },\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Handle file selection in the browser view\n  const handleFileSelect = (file: FileItem) =\u003e {\n    setSelectedEvidence({\n      id: file.id,\n      type: file.type,\n      status: 'active',\n      date: '2077-03-15',\n      details: &#96;Evidence file: ${file.name}&#96;,\n      metadata: {\n        createdBy: 'System',\n        lastModified: '2077-03-15 21:27:18',\n        fileSize: file.size || 'Unknown',\n        format: file.name.split('.').pop()?.toUpperCase() || 'Unknown',\n      },\n    })\n  }",

        "contents": "\n\n// Hook for documents with pagination and filtering\nexport const useDocuments = (initialParams: {\n  docType?: string;\n  tags?: string;\n  limit?: number;\n} = {}) =\u003e {\n  const [documents, setDocuments] = useState\u003cDocumentSummary[]\u003e([]);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null);\n  const [hasMore, setHasMore] = useState(true);\n  const [offset, setOffset] = useState(0);\n\n  const loadDocuments = useCallback(async (\n    params: typeof initialParams = initialParams,\n    reset = false\n  ) =\u003e {\n    try {\n      setLoading(true);\n      setError(null);\n      \n      const currentOffset = reset ? 0 : offset;\n      const data = await getDocuments({\n        ...params,\n        offset: currentOffset,\n        limit: params.limit || 20\n      });\n\n      if (reset) {\n        setDocuments(data);\n        setOffset(data.length);\n      } else {\n        setDocuments(prev =\u003e [...prev, ...data]);\n        setOffset(prev =\u003e prev + data.length);\n      }\n\n      setHasMore(data.length === (params.limit || 20));\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Failed to fetch documents');\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false);\n    }\n  }, [offset, initialParams]);\n\n  const loadMore = useCallback(() =\u003e {\n    if (!loading \u0026\u0026 hasMore) {\n      loadDocuments();\n    }\n  }, [loadDocuments, loading, hasMore]);\n\n  const refresh = useCallback((newParams?: typeof initialParams) =\u003e {\n    setOffset(0);\n    loadDocuments(newParams || initialParams, true);\n  }, [loadDocuments, initialParams]);\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    refresh();\n  }, []);\n\n  return {\n    documents,\n    loading,\n    error,\n    hasMore,\n    loadMore,\n    refresh\n  };\n};",

\"@/components/ui/badge\"\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\"\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\"\nimport { Textarea } from \"@/components/ui/textarea\"\nimport { Download,\n  Printer,\n  MessageSquare,\n  MapPin,\n  Terminal,\n  Eraser,\n} from \"lucide-react\"\nimport { type DocumentFile, getDocumentById, getDocumentsByType, getDocumentContent } from         "contents": "import { Editor } from '@tiptap/react'\nimport { RAGLLMHandler } from '@/lib/tiptap/custom-llm-handler'\nimport { toast } from '@/components/ui/use-toast'\nimport { useState } from 'react'\n\nexport function useRAGCommands(editor: Editor | null) {\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)\n  const ragHandler = new RAGLLMHandler()\n\n  const handleRAGSearch = async () =\u003e {\n    if (!editor) return\n    \n    const { from, to } = editor.state.selection\n    const selectedText = editor.state.doc.textBetween(from, to)\n    \n    if (!selectedText) {\n      toast({\n        title: \"No text selected\",\n        description: \"Please select text to search in the knowledge base.\",\n        variant: \"destructive\"\n      })\n      return\n    }\n\n    setLoading(true)\n    try {\n      const results = await ragHandler.searchDocuments(selectedText)\n      \n      if (results.length === 0) {\n        toast({\n          title: \"No results found\",\n          description: \"No relevant documents found in the knowledge base.\",\n        })\n        return\n      }\n      \n      // For now, insert the first result as a comment\n      // In a full implementation, show a modal to select from results\n      const firstResult = results[0]\n      editor.chain()\n        .focus()\n        .insertContent(&#96;\\n\\n**Related Document:** ${firstResult.title}\\n${firstResult.summary}\\n&#96;)\n        .run()\n        \n      toast({\n        title: \"Search complete\",\n        description: &#96;Found ${results.length} related documents.&#96;,\n      })\n    } catch (error) {\n      toast({\n        title: \"Search failed\",\n        description: \"Could not search the knowledge base. Please try again.\",\n        variant: \"destructive\"\n      })\n    } finally {\n      setLoading(false)\n    }\n  }",

const [selectedText, setSelectedText] = useState(\"\")\n  const [annotations, setAnnotations] = useState\u003cany[]\u003e([])\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!containerRef.current) return\n\n    const handleTextSelection = () =\u003e {\n      const selection = window.getSelection()\n      if (selection \u0026\u0026 selection.toString().trim() !== \"\") {\n        const range = selection.getRangeAt(0)\n        const rect = range.getBoundingClientRect()\n\n        setSelectedText(selection.toString())\n        setContextMenu({\n          x: rect.left + rect.width / 2,\n          y: rect.bottom + window.scrollY,\n        })\n      }\n    }\n\n    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) =\u003e {\n      if (contextMenu \u0026\u0026 containerRef.current \u0026\u0026 !containerRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {\n        setContextMenu(null)\n        setSelectedText(\"\")\n      }\n    }\n\n    containerRef.current.addEventListener(\"mouseup\", handleTextSelection)\n    document.addEventListener(\"mousedown\", handleClickOutside)\n\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (containerRef.current) {\n        containerRef.current.removeEventListener(\"mouseup\", handleTextSelection)\n      }\n      document.removeEventListener(\"mousedown\", handleClickOutside)\n    }\n  }, [containerRef, contextMenu])\n\n timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),\n    }\n\n    setAnnotations((prev) =\u003e [...prev, newAnnotation])\n    closeContextMenu()\n  }\n\n  const clearAnnotations = () =\u003e {\n    setAnnotations([])\n  }",

The fixes I implemented have resolved both issues:

## Summary of Fixes Applied

### 1. **Removed Xata from transpilePackages**
- **Problem**: The `@db` package was being unnecessarily transpiled for the browser in `next.config.ts`, causing the Xata client to be exposed to the browser environment
- **Solution**: Removed `"@db"` from the `transpilePackages` array since the research-canvas app doesn't actually import or use the Xata client

### 2. **Fixed Server-Side Rendering Issue in DragElements**
- **Problem**: The `DragElements` component was trying to access `window` during server-side rendering
- **Solution**: Added proper browser environment checks and used `useEffect` to set initial positions only after the component mounts on the client side

### 3. **Fixed Component Props Issues**
- **Problem**: `TapedNote` component was missing required `record` prop and `AnimatedFolder` had incorrect prop structure
- **Solution**: Added mock data for `TapedNote` and corrected the `AnimatedFolder` props to use `files` array instead of `children`

## Current Status
The research-canvas app is now running successfully at `http://localhost:3000` with:
- ✅ No Xata browser security errors
- ✅ No server-side rendering errors  
- ✅ All components rendering properly
- ✅ All TypeScript linting errors resolved

        "originalContents": "'use client'\nimport IntegratedDashboard from '@/components/integrated-dashboard'\nimport KnowledgeBaseBrowser from '@/components/knowledge-base-browser'\nimport './globals.css'\nimport {TapedNote} from '@/components/taped-note/taped-note'\nimport AnimatedFolder from '@/components/animated-folder'\n\nimport DeskFiles from '@/components/desk-files'\nimport ClassifiedDocumentViewer from '@/components/research-base/classified-document-viewer'\nimport {Database} from 'lucide-react'\nimport DatabaseWithRestApi from 'database-animation'\n\nexport default async function Index() {\n  // Mock record for TapedNote component\n  const mockRecord = {\n    id: 1,\n    year: '2024',\n    type: 'Research',\n    category: 'CLASSIFIED',\n    title: 'ULTRATERRESTRIAL RESEARCH',\n    image: '/placeholder-logo.png',\n    isLocked: false,\n  }\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className='min-h-screen bg-neutral-950 pt-20 p-12'\u003e\n      \u003cIntegratedDashboard /\u003e\n      \u003cKnowledgeBaseBrowser /\u003e\n      \u003cClassifiedDocumentViewer /\u003e\n      \u003cTapedNote record={mockRecord} /\u003e\n      \u003cAnimatedFolder\n        folder={{\n          id: 'folder-1',\n          name: 'Folder 1',\n          files: [\n            {id: 'file-1', name: 'File 1', type: 'file'},\n            {id: 'file-2', name: 'File 2', type: 'file'},\n          ],\n        }}\n      /\u003e\n      \u003cAnimatedFolder\n        folder={{\n          id: 'folder-2',\n          name: 'Folder 2',\n          files: [],\n        }}\n      /\u003e\n      \u003cAnimatedFolder\n        folder={{\n          id: 'folder-3',\n          name: 'Folder 3',\n          files: [],\n        }}\n      /\u003e\n      \u003cDeskFiles /\u003e\n      \u003cDatabaseWithRestApi /\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "# TipTap RAG Integration - Implementation Guide\n\n**Created:** June 28, 2025  \n**Version:** 1.0  \n**Location:** @apps/research-canvas/  \n\n## Overview\n\nThis implementation integrates TipTap AI capabilities with the Disclosure RAG system in the research-canvas application. Admin users can configure whether to connect to a local RAG server or remote API, and the editor provides AI-powered research assistance through natural language queries.\n\n## Features Implemented\n\n### ✅ Admin Configuration Panel\n- Toggle RAG integration on/off\n- Switch between local and remote RAG servers\n- Test connections before saving\n- Secure API key storage for remote connections\n\n### ✅ RAG-Enhanced Editor\n- Extends the existing TipTap simple editor\n- RAG mention system (type &#96;@@&#96; to search)\n- AI dropdown menu with RAG commands\n- Real-time knowledge base integration\n\n### ✅ AI Commands Available\n- **Search Knowledge** - Find related documents\n- **Fact Check** - Verify claims against knowledge base\n- **Add Citation** - Insert inline citations\n- **Elaborate with Context** - Expand text using related sources\n- **Summarize with Sources** - Create summaries with references\n\n### ✅ Custom LLM Handler\n- Interfaces with both local and remote RAG APIs\n- Handles authentication and error recovery\n- Caches settings for performance\n\n## File Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\napps/research-canvas/src/\n├── components/\n│   ├── admin/\n│   │   └── rag-settings.tsx                 # Admin settings panel\n│   ├── tiptap-extension/\n│   │   └── rag/\n│   │       ├── rag-mention.tsx              # RAG mention extension\n│   │       └── rag-suggestion-list.tsx      # Suggestion dropdown UI\n│   ├── tiptap-templates/\n│   │   └── rag-enhanced/\n│   │       └── rag-enhanced-editor.tsx      # Enhanced editor with RAG\n│   └── tiptap-ui/\n│       └── rag-dropdown/\n",

        "originalContents": "# TipTap RAG Integration - Implementation Guide\n\n**Created:** June 28, 2025  \n**Version:** 1.0  \n**Location:** @apps/research-canvas/  \n\n## Overview\n\nThis implementation integrates TipTap AI capabilities with the Disclosure RAG system in the research-canvas application. Admin users can configure whether to connect to a local RAG server or remote API, and the editor provides AI-powered research assistance through natural language queries.\n\n## Features Implemented\n\n### ✅ Admin Configuration Panel\n- Toggle RAG integration on/off\n- Switch between local and remote RAG servers\n- Test connections before saving\n- Secure API key storage for remote connections\n\n### ✅ RAG-Enhanced Editor\n- Extends the existing TipTap simple editor\n- RAG mention system (type &#96;@@&#96; to search)\n- AI dropdown menu with RAG commands\n- Real-time knowledge base integration\n\n### ✅ AI Commands Available\n- **Search Knowledge** - Find related documents\n- **Fact Check** - Verify claims against knowledge base\n- **Add Citation** - Insert inline citations\n- **Elaborate with Context** - Expand text using related sources\n- **Summarize with Sources** - Create summaries with references\n\n### ✅ Custom LLM Handler\n- Interfaces with both local and remote RAG APIs\n- Handles authentication and error recovery\n- Caches settings for performance\n\n## File Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\napps/research-canvas/src/\n├── components/\n│   ├── admin/\n│   │   └── rag-settings.tsx                 # Admin settings panel\n│   ├── tiptap-extension/\n│   │   └── rag/\n│   │       ├── rag-mention.tsx              # RAG mention extension\n│   │       └── rag-suggestion-list.tsx      # Suggestion dropdown UI\n│   ├── tiptap-templates/\n│   │   └── rag-enhanced/\n│   │       └── rag-enhanced-editor.tsx      # Enhanced editor with RAG\n│   └── tiptap-ui/\n│       └── rag-dropdown/\n",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n**Case Files:**\n- CIA Documents (RDP series)\n- UFO/UAP Reports  \n- Project Blue Book files\n- Congressional Hearings\n- Witness Testimony\n- Roswell Incident files\n\n**Transcripts:**\n- Joe Rogan Podcast episodes\n- Military/Navy testimonies\n- Disclosure-related interviews\n- David Grusch testimonies\n- Luis Elizondo interviews\n\n## Development\n\n### Environment Variables\n\nCreate &#96;.env.local&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\nNEXT_PUBLIC_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_API_URL=http://localhost:8000\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Commands\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install dependencies\nnpm install\n\n# Start development server\nnpm run dev\n\n# Build for production\nnpm run build\n\n# Start production server\nnpm start\n\n# Run linting\nnpm run lint\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\napps/research-canvas/\n├── components/\n│   ├── ui/                    # Reusable UI components\n│   ├── integrated-dashboard.tsx   # Main dashboard\n│   ├── knowledge-base-browser.tsx # Knowledge base interface\n│   └── ...\n├── hooks/\n│   └── use-knowledge-base.ts  # Data fetching hooks\n├── lib/\n│   ├── knowledge-base-api.ts  # API client functions\n│   └── utils.ts              # Utility functions\n├── app/                      # Next.js app directory\n├── utils/                    # Data utilities\n└── ...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## API Integration\n\n### Available Endpoints\n\n- &#96;GET /stats&#96; - Knowledge base statistics\n- &#96;GET /documents&#96; - List documents with filtering\n- &#96;GET /documents/{id}&#96; - Get specific document\n- &#96;GET /search&#96; - Search documents\n- &#96;GET /tags&#96; - Available tags\n- &#96;GET /categories&#96; - Document categories\n\n### Example Usage\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\nimport { getDocuments, searchDocuments } from './lib/knowledge-base-api';\n\n// Get CIA documents\nconst ciaFiles = await getDocuments({ \n  tags: 'cia', \n  docType: 'case_file' \n});\n\n// Search for UFO sightings\nconst results = await searchDocuments({ \n  query: 'UFO sighting', \n  limit: 20 \n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Customization\n\n### Adding New Components\n",

        "originalContents": "\n**Case Files:**\n- CIA Documents (RDP series)\n- UFO/UAP Reports  \n- Project Blue Book files\n- Congressional Hearings\n- Witness Testimony\n- Roswell Incident files\n\n**Transcripts:**\n- Joe Rogan Podcast episodes\n- Military/Navy testimonies\n- Disclosure-related interviews\n- David Grusch testimonies\n- Luis Elizondo interviews\n\n## Development\n\n### Environment Variables\n\nCreate &#96;.env.local&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;env\nNEXT_PUBLIC_KNOWLEDGE_BASE_API_URL=http://localhost:8000\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Commands\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;bash\n# Install dependencies\nnpm install\n\n# Start development server\nnpm run dev\n\n# Build for production\nnpm run build\n\n# Start production server\nnpm start\n\n# Run linting\nnpm run lint\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Project Structure\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\napps/research-canvas/\n├── components/\n│   ├── ui/                    # Reusable UI components\n│   ├── integrated-dashboard.tsx   # Main dashboard\n│   ├── knowledge-base-browser.tsx # Knowledge base interface\n│   └── ...\n├── hooks/\n│   └── use-knowledge-base.ts  # Data fetching hooks\n├── lib/\n│   ├── knowledge-base-api.ts  # API client functions\n│   └── utils.ts              # Utility functions\n├── app/                      # Next.js app directory\n├── utils/                    # Data utilities\n└── ...\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## API Integration\n\n### Available Endpoints\n\n- &#96;GET /stats&#96; - Knowledge base statistics\n- &#96;GET /documents&#96; - List documents with filtering\n- &#96;GET /documents/{id}&#96; - Get specific document\n- &#96;GET /search&#96; - Search documents\n- &#96;GET /tags&#96;         "contents": "│           └── rag-dropdown.tsx             # RAG commands dropdown\n├── app/\n│   ├── admin/\n│   │   └── page.tsx                         # Admin settings page\n│   ├── api/\n│   │   └── admin/\n│   │       ├── rag-settings/route.ts        # Settings API endpoint\n│   │       └── rag-test/route.ts            # Connection test endpoint\n│   └── research/\n│       └── page.tsx                         # Research page with editor\n├── hooks/\n│   ├── use-rag-commands.ts                  # RAG command handlers\n│   └── use-rag-settings.ts                 # Settings management hook\n└── lib/\n    └── tiptap/\n        └── custom-llm-handler.ts            # RAG API interface\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Getting Started\n\n### 1. Prerequisites\n\n- Node.js 18+ and Bun\n- Running disclosure-rag server (for local mode)\n- Admin access to configure settings\n\n### 2. Installation\n\nThe RAG integration is already included in the research-canvas build. No additional installation required.\n\n### 3. Configuration\n\n1. Navigate to &#96;/admin&#96; in the research-canvas app\n2. Toggle \"RAG Integration\" to enable\n3. Choose connection mode:\n   - **Local Server**: For development, connects to &#96;http://localhost:8000&#96;\n   - **Remote API**: For production, requires API URL and key\n4. Test the connection\n5. Save settings\n\n### 4. Usage\n\n1. Go to &#96;/research&#96; and click \"AI RESEARCH EDITOR\" tab\n2. Start typing in the editor\n3. Type &#96;@@&#96; followed by search terms to access knowledge base\n4. Select text and use the \"AI Knowledge\" dropdown for commands\n5.         "contents": "# Animated Background Component\n\n## Overview\nA complex animated SVG background component that creates a futuristic grid system with animated lines, circles, and geometric shapes.\n\n## Key Features\n- **Animated Grid Lines**: Horizontal and vertical lines that grow from zero width\n- **Intersection Circles**: Small circles that fade in at grid intersections\n- **Geometric Shapes**: Animated rectangles and paths with stroke animations\n- **Gradient Effects**: Multiple linear and radial gradients for visual depth\n- **Backdrop Filters**: Blur effects on circle elements\n\n## Architecture\n\n### Animation System\n- Uses Framer Motion for all animations\n- Four main animation variants:\n  - &#96;rectGrowVariants&#96;: For growing line animations\n  - &#96;circleVariants&#96;: For circle fade-in and stroke drawing\n  - &#96;dashVariants&#96;: For geometric shape stroke animations\n  - &#96;lineVariants&#96;: For path drawing animations\n\n### Component Structure\n- **SVG Container**: Fixed positioned, centered background element\n- **Gradient Definitions**: Complex gradient system for visual effects\n- **Filter Definitions**: Backdrop blur filters for depth\n- **Animated Elements**: Motion components for each animated element\n\n### Data Flow\n1. Component mounts and sets &#96;isVisible&#96; to true\n2. All motion elements animate from \"hidden\" to \"visible\" state\n3. Different animation timings create staggered effect\n4. Animations run once on mount\n\n## Usage\n\\&#96;\\&#96;\\&#96;tsx\nimport AnimatedBackground from \"./AnimatedBackground\"\n\nexport default function Page() {\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"relative\"\u003e\n      \u003cAnimatedBackground /\u003e\n      {/* Your content */}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n\\&#96;\\&#96;\\&#96;\n\n## Customization\n- Modify animation durations in variant objects\n- Adjust gradient colors in SVG definitions\n- Change positioning via CSS classes\n- Add new animated elements following existing patterns\n",

        "originalContents": "\"use client\"\nimport Link from \"next/link\"\nimport { usePathname } from \"next/navigation\"\nimport { motion } from \"framer-motion\"\nimport { Database, Network, AlertTriangle, BookOpen } from \"lucide-react\"\n\nexport default function NavigationBar() {\n  const pathname = usePathname()\n\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"fixed top-4 left-1/2 transform -translate-x-1/2 z-50\"\u003e\n      \u003cdiv className=\"flex items-center gap-2 bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-sm border border-neutral-800 rounded-lg p-1\"\u003e\n        \u003cLink href=\"/\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv\n            className={&#96;relative flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors ${\n              pathname === \"/\" ? \"text-neutral-200\" : \"text-neutral-500 hover:text-neutral-300\"\n            }&#96;}\n          \u003e\n            \u003cDatabase className=\"h-4 w-4\" /\u003e\n            \u003cspan className=\"font-mono text-sm\"\u003eDashboard\u003c/span\u003e\n\n            {pathname === \"/\" \u0026\u0026 (\n              \u003cmotion.div\n                layoutId=\"active-tab\"\n                className=\"absolute inset-0 bg-neutral-800/50 rounded-md -z-10\"\n                initial={false}\n                transition={{ type: \"spring\", duration: 0.5 }}\n              /\u003e\n            )}\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/Link\u003e\n\n        \u003cLink href=\"/connections\"\u003e\n          \u003cdiv\n            className={&#96;relative flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 rounded-md transition-colors ${\n              pathname === \"/connections\" ? \"text-neutral-200\" : \"text-neutral-500 hover:text-neutral-300\"\n            }&#96;}\n          \u003e\n            \u003cNetwork className=\"h-4 w-4\" /\u003e\n            \u003cspan className=\"font-mono text-sm\"\u003eInvestigations\u003c/span\u003e\n\n            {pathname === \"/connections\" \u0026\u0026 (\n              \u003cmotion.div\n                layoutId=\"active-tab\"\n                className=\"absolute inset-0 bg-neutral-800/50 rounded-md -z-10\"\n                initial={false}\n                transition={{ type: \"spring\", duration: 0.5 }}\n              /\u003e\n            )}\n          \u003c/div\u003e\n        \u003c/Link\u003e",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "1. Create component in &#96;components/&#96; directory\n2. Export from main dashboard\n3. Add to navigation tabs if needed\n\n### Extending the API\n1. Add new functions to &#96;lib/knowledge-base-api.ts&#96;\n2. Create hooks in &#96;hooks/use-knowledge-base.ts&#96;\n3. Use in components\n\n### Styling\n- Uses Tailwind CSS for styling\n- Dark theme optimized for research environments\n- Sci-fi inspired design with classification elements\n\n## Security Considerations\n\n- All API calls are client-side (no sensitive data exposure)\n- Classification banners for document security\n- Environment-based API URL configuration\n- No authentication required for local development\n\n## Troubleshooting\n\n### API Connection Issues\n1. Ensure the knowledge base API is running on port 8000\n2. Check the &#96;.env.local&#96; file has the correct API URL\n3. Verify no firewall is blocking the connection\n\n### Missing Documents\n1. Check the API health endpoint: &#96;http://localhost:8000/health&#96;\n2. Verify the knowledge base is indexed\n3. Check the API logs for errors\n\n### Performance Issues\n1. The initial load fetches statistics and first 20 documents\n2. Search and filtering are optimized for large datasets\n3. Pagination prevents memory issues with large result sets\n\nThis research canvas provides a sophisticated interface for exploring the complete UFO/UAP knowledge base with modern web technologies and security considerations.",

            "lineNumber": 168,
            "text": "2. Export from main dashboard"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 169,
            "text": "3. Add to navigation tabs if needed"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 170
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 171,
            "text": "### Extending the API"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 172,
            "text": "1. Add new functions to &#96;lib/knowledge-base-api.ts&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 173,
            "text": "2. Create hooks in &#96;hooks/use-knowledge-base.ts&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 174,
            "text": "3. Use in components"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 175
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 176,
            "text": "### Styling"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 177,
            "text": "- Uses Tailwind CSS for styling"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 178,
            "text": "- Dark theme optimized for research environments"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 179,
            "text": "- Sci-fi inspired design with classification elements"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 180
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 181,
            "text": "## Security Considerations"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 182
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 183,
            "text": "- All API calls are client-side (no sensitive data exposure)"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 184,
            "text": "- Classification banners for document security"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 185,
            "text": "- Environment-based API URL configuration"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 186,
            "text": "- No authentication required for local development"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 187
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 188,
            "text": "## Troubleshooting"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 189
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 190,
            "text": "### API Connection Issues"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 191,
            "text": "1. Ensure the knowledge base API is running on port 8000"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 192,
            "text": "2. Check the &#96;.env.local&#96; file has the correct API URL"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 193,
            "text": "3. Verify no firewall is blocking the connection"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 195,
            "text": "### Missing Documents"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 196,
            "text": "1. Check the API health endpoint: &#96;http://localhost:8000/health&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 197,
            "text": "2. Verify the knowledge base is indexed"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 198,
            "text": "3. Check the API logs for errors"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 200,
            "text": "### Performance Issues"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 201,
            "text": "1. The initial load fetches statistics and first 20 documents"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 202,
            "text": "2. Search and filtering are optimized for large datasets"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 203,
            "text": "3. Pagination prevents memory issues with large result sets"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 205,
            "text": "This research canvas provides a sophisticated interface for exploring the complete UFO/UAP knowledge base with modern web technologies and security considerations."
          }
        ],
